preheader: AI spend forecasts weigh on markets, Apple plans agentic Siri, and Alcaraz wins in Paris.

lead.headline: Capital Economics projects a 12% S&P 500 drop by 2027 as AI spending cools
lead.body: Capital Economics predicts U.S. stocks will fall over the next two years as revenue fails to keep pace with massive AI infrastructure spending. Chief Economic Adviser Vicky Redwood noted that while AI boosts worker productivity, current corporate investment rates look difficult to sustain.
lead.why: Understanding when capital expenditure booms hit revenue bottlenecks helps you evaluate tech stock valuations in your finance courses and investment research.

figures.label: projected S&P 500 decline by end of 2027

stories.headline: Vanguard and Fidelity lower ten-year U.S. stock return forecasts
stories.body: Vanguard projects U.S. stocks will return 4.8% to 6.8% annually over the next decade, while Fidelity expects 5.8%. Both estimates are less than half of the 15.2% annual returns seen over the past ten years.
stories.why: This forecast gives you realistic return expectations when modeling long-term asset allocation and portfolio strategies in your Merage finance classes.

stories.headline: Japan's Nikkei slides nearly 6% in sharp tech sell-off
stories.body: The benchmark Nikkei index fell 3,643 points in a single day, marking a 5.96% drop amid global tech stock weakness. The broader TOPIX index also fell 5.90%, closing out a steep weekly decline.
stories.why: Tracking cross-border market reactions helps you understand how shifts in U.S. tech sentiment ripple through global financial markets.

stories.headline: Apple aims to transform Siri into a proactive AI agent
stories.body: Following its personalized Siri release in iOS 27, Apple is working to give Siri autonomous agent capabilities as soon as next year. The update aims to allow Siri to take actions proactively on behalf of users.
stories.why: Agentic AI is becoming the dominant product frontier, offering inspiration if you are looking to build or evaluate consumer software startups.

stories.headline: AI tech giants team up with Big Oil for data center energy
stories.body: OpenAI formed a partnership with energy firm ADNOC as tech companies seek gas-fired power for energy-hungry data centers. A recent study flags that these energy deals are driving up overall carbon emissions.
stories.why: Energy availability and sustainability are becoming major operational constraints that you will analyze in tech consulting case interviews.

stories.headline: McKinsey study examines using AI to capture CEO decision-making
stories.body: A new McKinsey report shows artificial intelligence can capture executive decision-making logic and leadership knowledge to share across an organization. This helps companies standardize strategic decisions and reduce dependency on individual leaders.
stories.why: Knowledge management and leadership automation are high-value frameworks you can highlight during management consulting interviews.

stories.headline: McKinsey highlights need for automated cybersecurity overhauls
stories.body: McKinsey reports that companies must rethink cybersecurity strategies as frontier AI makes it easier for attackers to identify software vulnerabilities. Organizations are being urged to increase investments in automated threat detection.
stories.why: Cybersecurity strategy is expanding rapidly within tech consulting, opening up specialized project opportunities for business interns.

stories.headline: UC Irvine men's basketball tops San Jose State 91-79
stories.body: The Anteaters opened the game with a 13-0 run and led by 20 at halftime to beat San Jose State at the Bren Events Center. Jovan Jester Jr. led UCI with 24 points and eight rebounds to move the team to 2-0.

stories.headline: Carlos Alcaraz defeats Ben Shelton to claim Paris Masters title
stories.body: Carlos Alcaraz won his first Paris Masters title with a 7-6 (5), 7-5 straight-sets victory over Ben Shelton. The win served as revenge after Shelton eliminated Alcaraz from the US Open earlier this season.

term.name: Hyperscaler
term.definition: A massive cloud service provider that operates global data center infrastructure for cloud computing and AI workloads. Current market analyses focus on whether hyperscalers can generate sufficient software revenue to justify their high capital expenditures.

serve.headline: San Diego founder sells out micro-batch apartment pizzas in 30 seconds
serve.body: AJ Miller bakes just 15 New Haven-style pizzas per week out of his Ocean Beach apartment without a commercial kitchen, selling them for $25 to $30 each. Over 3,500 people compete in a weekly lottery queue to buy the limited pies.
